columns_never_fillable.reason: CLINT discloses 'Floor area owned by CLINT' (built/owned area in million sq ft) per card — captured in gfa. Data centres disclose Built-up Area + MW capacity (no lettable-area metric). No gross/net LETTABLE area is disclosed per property.
Per-property NPI is disclosed only as INR-million and as a % contribution (NPI donut, p26), not as an absolute SGD figure. Captured the % in npi_pct; absolute left null.

Per-property total property income is disclosed only in INR-million (financial review, p25), not in the SGD schema unit. Stored as % (npi_pct) and INR figures in data_with_no_home; absolute SGD per-property revenue not disclosed, so kept null to avoid a fabricated cross-currency conversion.
Tenants are disclosed only at portfolio level (Top 10 Tenants table, p41); no per-property tenant breakdown is given.

Per-property 'Purchase price' is disclosed on the property cards (p44-50) for the existing portfolio and captured for 13 rows. NOT disclosed for 3 active/divested rows: (1) CapitaLand Data Centre ITPB — card shows 'Purchase price: –' (p50, footnote 22: development on hold; DC sits on land within ITPB already counted in the ITPB card); (2) CyberVale and (3) CyberPearl — divested 29 Sep 2025, no property cards; only a COMBINED divestment consideration INR 11.0b / S$161.7m is given (a sale price, not an acquisition cost), so no per-property purchase price exists to record.
No single weighted-average-lease-expiry (years) figure disclosed; only a lease-expiry profile by rental revenue and city (p40).
No weighted-average debt maturity (years) disclosed; only a debt-maturity profile bar chart by fiscal year (p31).
Externally managed business trust; no trust-level employees. Trustee-Manager headcount not disclosed in the report.
